name: Safety Evidence Factory - Battery Thermal Guardian
description: A reusable safety evidence pipeline for SDV services: seeded fault campaigns hit the signal, transport, heartbeat and diagnostics layers of a battery thermal guardian; every injected fault is traced over Eclipse uProtocol to its detection, mitigation and DTC in Eclipse OpenSOVD, judged PASS / FAIL / INCONCLUSIVE against a hazard and safety-goal catalog, and packaged as a checksummed evidence bundle. Runs with one command under Eclipse Ankaios and in CI.
